analysis: Paired uncertainty of smaller DAEWC against all seven reference methods and the width-2 adapter baseline on the second test. Report every comparison separately under fixed and internal-CV protocols.
metric: Macro-F1 percentage-point difference; average domains equally within each seed, then average three seeds.
bootstrap: 2000 draws; sample three seeds with replacement, shared across domains; independently resample examples within each original domain and label class, pairing indices across all methods. Class counts and the three domains remain fixed.
interval: Percentile 2.5 and 97.5; descriptive conditional uncertainty, no p-value or population-wide superiority guarantee.
selection: None; do not change fitted models, configuration, thresholds, or comparison set.
